caseNameFull: Ricci v. Village of Arlington Heights

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with' the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, February 23,1998. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 25, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, April 10, 1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
